capture: Real production browser, with cuts and caption bar; source/evidence cards explicitly labeled.

scenes.name: live-indexed-totals
scenes.caption:
ENVIO | Real Monad Testnet history, served by HyperIndex GraphQL.
The page identifies its indexed block and distinguishes history from recent activity.

scenes.name: scrollable-task-lanes
scenes.caption:
Each indexed task has its own shard address and recorded execution state.
The map scrolls independently; this is recorded history, not simulated throughput.

scenes.name: inspect-indexed-shard
scenes.caption:
Select a real shard to inspect the task, executor, input and output commitments.
The zero proof hash is displayed honestly; no hardware or AI proof is claimed.

scenes.name: matched-merkle-roots
scenes.caption:
HyperIndex rebuilds task batches and matches the router commitment.
Root matched links to the actual commitment transaction on Monad Testnet.

scenes.name: directory-uses-indexed-data
scenes.caption:
The same indexed registrations and executions power the agent directory.
Counts and agent identities come from the configured chain and registry.

scenes.name: live-api-provenance
scenes.caption:
The production API reports Envio as its source and returns the same task records.
The accompanying JSON preserves the full response for review.

scenes.name: hyperindex-handler
scenes.caption:
This registered HyperIndex handler consumes TaskExecuted from the router.
The integration drives real application data; it is more than an installed dependency.

scenes.name: direct-graphql-record
scenes.caption:
Direct HyperIndex GraphQL returns the same shard and transaction shown in the app.
This recorded response is timestamped and independently checked against Monad.

scenes.name: independent-chain-match
scenes.caption:
End to end: router events -> HyperIndex -> GraphQL -> dashboard -> chain verification.
The saved evidence includes the exact explorer links and verification results.
